HEADPHONES RECOMMENDED

Tide Tables

THE STUDIO IS OPEN. A documentary series recorded along the Bristol Channel over three winters, following the people who still work the highest tidal range in Europe.

Nine episodes, each built around a single day's fieldwork, with the ambient recordings presented unedited alongside the cut.

Method

Everything was captured on a pair of omnidirectional microphones at a fixed height, so the episodes can be compared to one another honestly.
